(ORDER LIST: 607 U.S.)
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 8, 2025
ORDER IN PENDING CASE
25A347 HAMM, COMM’R, AL DOC V. SOCKWELL, MICHAEL
The application for stay presented to Justice Thomas and by
him referred to the Court is denied. The denial is without
prejudice to a reapplication if a new trial is imminent. See
Calderon v. Moore, 518 U. S. 149 (1996) (per curiam); Garrison v.
Hudson, 468 U. S. 1301 (1984) (Burger, C. J., in chambers). The
order heretofore entered by Justice Thomas is vacated.
